title: S02T10 - Decide Ink/TUI runtime boundary for rich CLI dashboards
description: Evaluate whether Boreal should adopt Ink or keep dependency-light render primitives for rich terminal dashboards, with an explicit recommendation before implementation grows.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision compares dependency cost, testability, terminal cleanup, JSON/plain separation, and apps/tui ownership.
If Ink is deferred, the path to revisit it is documented; if adopted, package boundaries and tests are defined.
closedReason: Ink/TUI runtime boundary decision is documented with revisit and adoption conditions.
